summary: Iteration 19 verifies the Corners/Cards fully-priced fix, the 4 unpriced panels explanatory note, value-matches repopulation (119 live), snapshot-based restart (no provider calls), LION tickets Greek-only & parlay sanity, and player panels priced. 33/33 new backend tests pass. Frontend confirms: 75 .gr links on Specific Bets + 4 'No bookmaker prices this market...' notes + snapshot banner; 111 .gr links across 34 LION ticket cards (hosts: bet365.gr, elabet.gr, novibet.gr, bwin.gr, pamestoixima.gr only); Matches page renders Strong Opportunity cards.

fixtures_tested: live_af_1593333 (Kifisia vs Aris, Super League 1 Greece)
evidence.value_matches: GET /api/value-matches -> HTTP 200, source=live, count=119 (served from DB snapshot, response 0.3s)
evidence.quota_guard_restart: sudo supervisorctl restart backend; subsequent GET /api/value-matches returned 119 matches; backend log: 'live matches served from DB snapshot (11-12 min old) — no provider calls' (restart performed only once)
evidence.players_priced: Each fixture had priced player rows (anytime scorer / shots / shots on target) with bookmaker attached

critical_code_review_comments: specific_bets._lines() correctly returns ONLY lines quoted by a bookmaker — Corners/Cards panels have 2 rows each (one Over + one Under on the single quoted line) and both are priced; no dash rows observed on any of the 3 fixtures.

The 4 markets no Greek bookmaker quotes (Score At Any Time, Fouls, Offsides, Goalkeeper Saves) now carry panel-level `note` ending with "No bookmaker prices this market for this fixture — LION's own probability only." and every row still exposes `lion`/`market_pct` probabilities.

live_values.build_live_matches() correctly honours the 4h TTL + 6h-after-restart grace: backend restart produced the exact log line 'live matches served from DB snapshot ... no provider calls' and /api/value-matches still returned the full 119-match list in 0.3s.
LION tickets parlay math verified: parlay.odds <= product(leg odds)+0.01 on every ticket with a parlay; all legs link to .gr domains in the approved Greek-licensed set.
apifootball._sync_usage reading /status is correct for quota discipline; test run consumed zero fresh provider calls thanks to DB snapshot + 30-min odds cache.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canonical fixtures: live_af_1575188 (Bundesliga rich coverage, Correct Score 8/8, Cards 2/2, Corners 2/2), live_af_1563200 (Championship), live_af_1593333 (Greek Super League). Expected 4 unpriced panels per spec with explanatory note: Score At Any Time, Fouls, Offsides, Goalkeeper Saves. Corners/Cards each have exactly 2 priced rows (bookmakers only quote one Over/Under line). Backend restart is snapshot-safe (log 'no provider calls'); do not restart more than twice. /api/specific-bets responds in ~7s on warm cache, /api/lion-tickets takes 10-20s on warm cache (use 180s timeout for cold).
rca of the issue: User's complaint on first-see-no-odds was from yesterday's exhausted RapidAPI daily quota (nothing could be priced). Fix lands in two places: (1) backend/live_values.py now serves /api/value-matches from a DB snapshot (TTL 4h, grace 6h after restart) so the app NEVER goes blank from a restart; (2) specific_bets._lines() only returns bookmaker-quoted lines for Corners/Cards (no model-only phantom lines) so what is rendered is always priced; the four markets no .gr book quotes (Fouls/Offsides/GK Saves/Score At Any Time) stay unpriced BY DESIGN and show the explanatory note. Verified across 3 upcoming fixtures and across LION tickets (111 .gr links, 0 non-Greek).
